description: Default query set, used when QUERY_FILE is empty. Each query describes the question once in 'match' (backend-neutral, used for verification) and gives the query string for each backend or dialect in 'query'. Types are named by the conditions the question uses. Copy this file to define your own set; see README.md, 'Query sets'.

queries.name: all components, 25% of the time span

query.dsos: select * from {schema} where timestamp >= {t_q1} and timestamp < {t_mid} order_by timestamp
query.influxdb: SELECT * FROM {schema} WHERE timestamp >= {t_q1} AND timestamp < {t_mid} ORDER BY timestamp

queries.name: all components, 1% of the time span

query.dsos: select * from {schema} where timestamp >= {t_mid} and timestamp < {t_mid_1pct} order_by timestamp
query.influxdb: SELECT * FROM {schema} WHERE timestamp >= {t_mid} AND timestamp < {t_mid_1pct} ORDER BY timestamp

queries.name: one component on the first server

query.dsos: select * from {schema} where component_id == {comp_s0} order_by comp_time
query.influxdb: SELECT * FROM {schema} WHERE component_id = {comp_s0} ORDER BY component_id, timestamp

queries.name: one component on the last server

query.dsos: select * from {schema} where component_id == {comp_slast} order_by comp_time
query.influxdb: SELECT * FROM {schema} WHERE component_id = {comp_slast} ORDER BY component_id, timestamp

queries.name: one component, 25% of the time span

query.dsos: select * from {schema} where component_id == {comp_s0} and timestamp >= {t_q1} and timestamp < {t_mid} order_by comp_time
query.influxdb: SELECT * FROM {schema} WHERE component_id = {comp_s0} AND timestamp >= {t_q1} AND timestamp < {t_mid} ORDER BY component_id, timestamp

queries.name: one component, 25% of the time span (dsos: timestamp index)

query.dsos: select * from {schema} where component_id == {comp_s0} and timestamp >= {t_q1} and timestamp < {t_mid} order_by timestamp
query.influxdb: SELECT * FROM {schema} WHERE component_id = {comp_s0} AND timestamp >= {t_q1} AND timestamp < {t_mid} ORDER BY timestamp

queries.name: one component, 25% of the time span (dsos: job_comp_time index)

query.dsos: select * from {schema} where component_id == {comp_s0} and timestamp >= {t_q1} and timestamp < {t_mid} order_by job_comp_time
query.influxdb: SELECT * FROM {schema} WHERE component_id = {comp_s0} AND timestamp >= {t_q1} AND timestamp < {t_mid} ORDER BY job_id, component_id, timestamp

query.dsos: select * from {schema} where job_id == {job_mid} order_by job_comp_time
query.influxdb: SELECT * FROM {schema} WHERE job_id = {job_mid} ORDER BY job_id, component_id, timestamp

query.dsos: select * from {schema} where job_id == {job_mid} and component_id == {comp_slast} order_by job_comp_time
query.influxdb: SELECT * FROM {schema} WHERE job_id = {job_mid} AND component_id = {comp_slast} ORDER BY job_id, component_id, timestamp

queries.name: one job, one component, part of the job's time

query.dsos: select * from {schema} where job_id == {job_mid} and component_id == {comp_slast} and timestamp >= {t_mid} order_by job_comp_time
query.influxdb: SELECT * FROM {schema} WHERE job_id = {job_mid} AND component_id = {comp_slast} AND timestamp >= {t_mid} ORDER BY job_id, component_id, timestamp

queries.name: one job, part of its time, all components

query.dsos: select * from {schema} where job_id == {job_mid} and timestamp >= {t_mid} order_by job_comp_time
query.influxdb: SELECT * FROM {schema} WHERE job_id = {job_mid} AND timestamp >= {t_mid} ORDER BY job_id, component_id, timestamp

query.dsos: select * from {schema} where free < 50 order_by timestamp
query.influxdb: SELECT * FROM {schema} WHERE free < 50 ORDER BY timestamp

queries.name: selected columns, last 25% of the time span

query.dsos: select component_id, seq, free from {schema} where timestamp >= {t_q3} order_by timestamp
query.influxdb: SELECT component_id, seq, free FROM {schema} WHERE timestamp >= {t_q3} ORDER BY timestamp

queries.name: first rows by time, with a limit

query.influxdb: SELECT * FROM {schema} ORDER BY timestamp LIMIT {limit}

query.dsos: select job_id from {schema} where job_id <= 3 group_by job_id
query.influxdb: SELECT job_id FROM {schema} WHERE job_id <= 3 GROUP BY job_id
